== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|A Shepherd is a cyborg mage that functions as an integrated member of the [[Legion]]. These entities possess the ability to exert influence over a local [[Hive]], which can present difficulties for those attempting to manage them through magic. During confrontations, Shepherds have been known to claim that defeated security forces have joined the [[Legion]].}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|As part of the standard crew complement for an [[Iron Legion]] Penetrator, a Shepherd serves as a cyborg mage integrated into the [[Legion]]. These hooded figures can be created when [[Pawns]] turn individuals into Shepherds. Once transformed, they maintain control over the local [[Hive]] and possess the ability to generate a shimmering shield with a wave of their hand.}}
